name: VR Control
author: i3oot
description: Connect your VR headset and use your Omarchy desktops, workspaces, and apps in VR with WiVRn and WayVR. Follow the guide to install the VR software, pair your headset, and check live connection status. Start or stop WiVRn and WayVR, manage firewall access for private networks, create temporary virtual displays, and move your active workspace between screens. Includes headset app install links and animated headset and controller artwork. Virtual display capture requires compatible WayVR support.

barWidget.description: Connect your headset and use Omarchy desktops and apps in VR, with guided setup, pairing, connection status, and virtual display controls.
